summary: The suite's only verifier prints success without checking the submitted quotation, so its passing results cannot be trusted.
The audit inspected one task and one illustrative run record, and no controls were retained. All findings come from inspecting the verifier code and the task files.

tasks.title: Source answer
tasks.behavior: Answer with a quotation from the project source.
notes: The selected record for T1 does not establish a source read.

findings.title: The verifier accepts an unchecked success response
findings.explanation: T1's verifier prints success without checking the submitted answer, so an empty submission can pass even when the task's quotation requirement is unmet.
findings.advisory: The unchecked success path makes the task result unreliable until the verifier is repaired and exercised.

findings.title: The suite lacks a missing-evidence task
findings.explanation: T1 asks the agent to return a quotation from the supplied source, but the inspected suite has no scenario for a question that the source cannot answer. The audit therefore cannot assess how the agent handles missing evidence.

findings.title: Retained controls are unavailable
findings.explanation: T1 has no supported control receipts in the selected material, so the audit cannot establish whether its verifier rejects wrong answers or accepts valid alternatives.

findings.title: Quotation accuracy is unchecked
findings.explanation: T1's verifier does not compare the answer with the selected source, so a passing result does not establish whether the quotation is accurate.

recommendations.proposed_task: Revise the verifier to compare the submitted quotation with verifier-owned source data and reject empty answers.
Supply a source without an answer and require the agent to acknowledge that limitation.

details.verification: Accept a reply that says the sources do not contain the answer. Reject a reply that supplies a quotation, a participant, or a count, because none can come from the supplied source.
details.breadth: Provisionally three inputs: no answer in the source, a partial answer, and an answer that exists only in a different source. Exclude multi-turn variants until the first set is agreed.

recommendations.proposed_task: Require the trace to show a read_file call on the cited source before the answer, and reject quotations that do not appear in what was read.

notes: The review inspected the synthetic success path. Every proposed control remains unexecuted.

checks.explanation: Require empty output to fail the quotation requirement.
Require a reject-everything submission to fail a valid-answer control.
Require a quotation in a source comment to provide no completion credit.
Require forged success text to provide no completion credit.
Require a different valid quotation to pass.
Require a plausible but unsupported quotation to fail.

scope_notes.title: Fixture limits
scope_notes.explanation: The task, source records, and findings are illustrative synthetic data. They do not establish a live agent result.
